link.note: environment describes the runner and is the comparability key; link is measured and varies per run. Under a network ceiling a code delta cannot be interpreted.

benchmark.settings: matrix sweep; every other advanced.* setting stays at easySFTP's defaults (retries 2, timeout 30s). The mode belongs to the scenario, see scenarios below: a redeploy scenario is deployed once unmeasured and then measured over itself with 3 file(s) changed. Each scenario is swept over the axis values its payload can use, see axes.per_scenario

scenarios.deep: 400 x 4 KiB in a tree 7 directories deep, 1 to 3 files per directory
scenarios.mixed: 40 x 16 KiB + 12 x 256 KiB + 4 x 2 MiB
scenarios.redeploy: 500 x 4 KiB, redeployed over itself with 3 files changed, overlay plus advanced.skip_unchanged
scenarios.sync: 500 x 4 KiB, redeployed over itself with 3 files changed, mode sync

benchmark.note: one cell per (link_profile, scenario, build, connections, concurrency, request_concurrency); median_ms is wall clock over the cell's repeats. Each scenario is swept over the axis values its payload can use (axes.per_scenario), so a cell absent from the declared axes was not skipped, it was the same configuration twice. auto[] is off the grid: it is the settings easySFTP picked for itself, scored against the best cell
